# eon_finding_exclusions (Data Source)

Retrieves finding exclusions in the Eon project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "eon_finding_exclusions" "all" {}

output "finding_exclusion_ids" {
  value = [for exclusion in data.eon_finding_exclusions.all.exclusions : exclusion.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `exclusions` (Attributes List) Finding exclusions in the project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--exclusions))

<a id="nestedatt--exclusions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `exclusions`

Read-Only:

- `detector` (String) Detector whose findings this exclusion suppresses. Possible values: `RANSOMWARE_BEHAVIOR`, `DATA_ANOMALY`, `MALWARE`.
- `id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the finding exclusion.
- `resource_id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the resource the exclusion applies to. Unset when the exclusion applies to every resource in the account.
- `type` (String) What the exclusion refers to. Possible values: `PATH`, `TABLE`, `DATABASE`.
- `updated_at` (String) When the exclusion was created or last updated.
- `value` (String) What the exclusion matches. For `PATH`, a file path prefix. For `TABLE` or `DATABASE`, the exact table or database name.
